reason: A is the stronger proposal because CeO2–ZrO2 plausibly combines ceria’s oxygen-storage/redox function with improved thermal stabilization and includes a clearer durability-focused test against an unmodified baseline. Its evidence is incomplete—especially for ZrO2 and direct H2O/NO resistance—and a conformal coating could block alloy sites, but B provides no cited support and makes similarly unverified poisoning-resistance claims.
